summary: Israeli forces struck Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and five others. Iran conducted multiple missile and UAV activities including a ballistic missile test from Parchin and over 10 ASCM/SAM launches from Bandar Abbas. Israeli artillery shelled Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon while warplanes operated over the area.
key_points: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis targeted and killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail, with six dead and at least 20 wounded according to Hamas authorities. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)
Iran launched a ballistic missile test from Parchin in Tehran Province, as detected by monitoring systems. (Source: @shin_persian/12275)
Over 10 anti-ship cruise missiles or surface-to-air missiles were launched from Bandar Abbas in Hormozgan Province, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12280)
Israeli artillery shelled the outskirts of Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, with an explosion reported in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/52888)
Israeli warplanes were observed flying over southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/52874)

Israeli military and Border Police evacuated two illegal outposts near Atara and Wadi al-Rahim in the West Bank, dismantling structures and using riot dispersal means against Israeli rioters. (Source: @manniefabian/59511)
Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi directed that IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah be dealt with under Iraqi law, while Badr and PMF leadership sought more time for talks. (Source: @shin_persian/12282)
Prime Minister Netanyahu and military secretary Maj. Gen. Guy Markizeno briefed opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot on security and diplomatic challenges. (Source: @amitsegal/67176)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces struck Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and five others. Iran conducted multiple missile and UAV activities including a ballistic missile test from Parchin and over 10 ASCM/SAM launches from Bandar Abbas. Israeli artillery shelled Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon while warplanes operated over the area.

points: A UAV was launched from the Fifth Fighter Base in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province, as reported by Iranian monitoring channels with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12273)
A ballistic missile test launch occurred at 17:27 local time from Parchin in Tehran Province, identified as a test by monitoring systems. (Source: @shin_persian/12275)
Over 10 anti-ship cruise missiles or surface-to-air missiles were launched from Bandar Abbas in Hormozgan Province, indicating significant missile activity. (Source: @shin_persian/12280)
A blast was reported near Sarkhur Tahruyi in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, with no immediate claim of responsibility or cause provided. (Source: @shin_persian/12283)
Two UAVs were spotted over Baharestan and Sepahan Shahr in Isfahan Province, suggesting continued drone operations or surveillance. (Source: @shin_persian/12284)

Prime Minister Netanyahu and military secretary Maj. Gen. Guy Markizeno provided a security and diplomatic briefing to opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot at the Prime Minister's Office. (Source: @amitsegal/67176)

The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed an overnight strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis targeted Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail along with additional terrorists hiding at the facility. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)

Israeli military and Border Police evacuated two illegal outposts near the Palestinian villages of Atara and Wadi al-Rahim in the West Bank, dismantling structures, seizing vehicles and tents, and using riot dispersal means against Israeli rioters who barricaded themselves. (Source: @manniefabian/59511)
Former US President Trump stated the US does not need a deal with Iran and directed Vice President Vance to focus on corruption in Democratic-led cities instead. (Source: @amitsegal/67164)

An Israeli strike on the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis killed six people and wounded at least 20 others, according to Hamas authorities, targeting senior Hamas commander Muhammad Abu Ismail. (Source: @manniefabian/59505)

The IDF and Shin Bet stated the strike targeted Muhammad Abu Ismail, the latest commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, along with additional terrorists hiding at the hospital, with results still under review. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)

Israeli forces evacuated two illegal settlement outposts near Atara and Wadi al-Rahim in the West Bank, which the army described as sources of repeated violent and illegal activity by settlers against Palestinians. (Source: @manniefabian/59511)

During the outpost evacuation near Atara, Israeli rioters barricaded themselves in structures and attempted to prevent the removal, prompting forces to use riot dispersal means to complete the enforcement. (Source: @yediotnews25/137754)
Artillery shelling targeted the outskirts of Zoutar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, with live map tracking showing the impact area. (Source: @redlinkleb/52888)
An explosion was reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiya, with no immediate details on casualties or damage. (Source: @redlinkleb/52870)
Israeli warplanes were observed flying over southern Lebanon, indicated by live map tracking. (Source: @redlinkleb/52874)
Israeli warplanes were also tracked over the broader southern region of Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/52872)

Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi told Amiri and Fayyadh that IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah must be dealt with under Iraq's laws in force, while Badr and PMF leadership pushed for more time and talks instead, according to a single anonymous source via Shafaq. (Source: @shin_persian/12282)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Israeli strike on a Hamas command target in a Gaza hospital and Iranian missile launches from multiple sites indicate a high risk of multi-front escalation. Iran's ballistic missile test from Parchin and mass ASCM/SAM launches from Bandar Abbas demonstrate advanced readiness and potential signaling. Israeli artillery and air activity in southern Lebanon, combined with West Bank outpost removals, suggest a broadening operational tempo. The Iraqi government's move against Kataib Hezbollah could trigger proxy responses. These developments collectively point to a volatile period with elevated likelihood of direct or proxy clashes.
sections.regional_response: Israeli leadership is coordinating security briefings with opposition figures, signaling political unity amid military operations. The US under Trump appears to deprioritize Iran diplomacy, potentially emboldening Israeli action. Iraq's internal pressure on IRGC-backed groups reflects shifting Baghdad-Tehran dynamics. Lebanese authorities have not yet responded publicly to the shelling. Regional actors are likely assessing Iranian missile demonstrations as both deterrence and preparation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's use of delayed posting (120-second) for UAV and missile launches suggests operational security awareness. The Nasser Hospital strike indicates Israeli willingness to target high-value Hamas leaders in protected sites, risking international scrutiny. West Bank outpost evacuations reveal friction between settlement expansion and military priorities. Monitoring of Iranian missile launches from Bandar Abbas and Parchin provides rare visibility into IRGC force posture. The Iraqi directive on Kataib Hezbollah may test PMF cohesion.
